name: Ren
source:
An assassin who worked for the Thai underworld organization, New Moon, as a subordinate of No. 7.
He specializes in sniping.
He claims that he belonged to the underworld organization in order to control his uncontrollable urge to kill.
He survived No.7's death and came to Hong Kong by stowing away on the New Moon's drug smuggling ship.
He accompanied Yvet and Wolf on their mission to rescue Zhang Lei and lost his life.
